name: Pie chart board
summary: Presentation board on a tripod easel showing a coloured pie chart; anim grow sweeps the slices in.

params.name: y
params.note: floor point under the easel centre (1 m ~ 560 px)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the easel is about 500 px wide and 900 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: grow = the slices sweep in clockwise; frame 0 already shows about 35 % of the pie

author: krakujs
